evidence.quote: And it’s more likely to have been a woman than a man----
That man, Danvers, was shadowed on the way over, wasn’t he? I am absolutely certain that it would be a woman

adjudications.reason: The plan warns that the woman-shadower reasoning must stay framed as Tuppence's guess. V3's purpose is certainty 'which Tommy mocks'. The draft drops both the source hedge 'more likely' and Tommy's objection. It then fuses 'absolutely certain' and 'obviously ... was saved' into one chain of deduction. 'I admit it's only a chance' comes later and applies to the Rita link, not to the woman. Restoring the hedge and Tommy's two-line objection re-establishes intuition against doubt.

evidence.quote: “Buck up, old bean. We always knew it was an outside chance.”

adjudications.reason: In the draft, 'reviving' follows Tommy agreeing only that it was 'an outside chance', so her recovery has no cause. Restoring the source clause 'we're only starting', which survived in the first draft, gives the cheering a reason at a cost of five words.

evidence.quote: Hardly able to contain his excitement, Tommy hurried down the stairs. Tuppence was waiting at the angle of the turn.
It’s--it’s so lovely to think of things--and then for them really to happen!

adjudications.reason: This is a legitimate compression. Tommy's 'Hardly able to contain his excitement' and Tuppence's V7 cry still carry the joint rejoicing. Her waiting 'at the angle of the turn' and her delight make clear that she overheard. The scene, the lift-shadow beat and V8 are intact. Restoring 17 words would force cuts to required beats.

remaining_concerns: The plan's essential list names Sadie's suffrage lecture while its optional list says Sadie may be cut. Sadie was cut here to fund the F1 and F2 repairs.
The estimated net change is about -3 words against a target of -2.
